title: Jerusalem Artichoke Pilaf with Steamed Artichokes
description: A hearty and flavorful pilaf dish made with Jerusalem artichokes and steamed artichokes, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped Jerusalem artichokes and cook for 5 minutes until they start to brown.
Add the rice, chicken broth, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover with a tight-fitting lid.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
While the pilaf is cooking, steam the artichokes until tender.
Serve the pilaf hot, topped with steamed artichokes.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
